_comment: Utopian Landscaping and Paving Solutions, Canberra. Built 2026-09-22, revised 2026-09-23, from www.utopianlandscaping.com.au. Every specific fact on the page is quoted in _source.claimSources with the page it came from, or comes from data/google_reviews_top25.json. Nothing is inferred. No years in business, no prices, no awards, no licences and no home suburb are claimed — they publish none. See BRIEF.md.
tagline: Landscaping and paving across Canberra, Queanbeyan and Yass. Every part of the job by the one team.

brand._comment: Their logo's red samples at #D80000-#E00000, which only clears 3.7:1 on a dark page. The site accent is #F0483A (~4.9:1), so the wordmark is set in that lifted red, not their original red — it has been recoloured to match the site. The second colour is a sandstone gold taken off the Canberra stone in their own photos: a design choice, not a brand asset. Ask Derek for the brand red from his vector.

logo._comment: NOT their artwork. The only logo published anywhere is logo2-280x120.png: 280x120, JPEG-artefacted, with a grey halo and a white plate baked into the pixels and black drop-shadow squares behind the red confetti. Knocking it out left white specks and a grey fringe at the 32px the header renders it at, and the 'LANDSCAPING & PAVING SOLUTIONS' subline was illegible mush at that size, so nothing of theirs is used here. This is their name set in the page's own display face (Big Shoulders 700, lowercase) in the site accent red. It is a stand-in. Get the original vector from Derek and replace it before this goes live.

copy.title: Utopian Landscaping and Paving Solutions — Landscaping & Paving, Canberra
copy.description: Landscaping and paving in Canberra, Queanbeyan and Yass. Retaining walls, paving, decks, turf, irrigation and rockeries, all built by the one team. 5.0 from 25 Google reviews.
copy.headline:
Rough ideas
turned into
real gardens.
copy.sub: You do not need a plan drawn up. Tell Derek what you want the space to do, and his crew works out how to build it — then builds all of it. Paving, walls, decks, turf, irrigation and planting.
copy.heroSecondarySms: Or text a photo of the space
copy.statementBody: Most yards get carved up between a paver, a chippy, a fencer and a turf bloke, and you end up in the middle chasing all four. We do every part of it ourselves. One quote, one crew on site, and one number to ring when you have a question.
copy.servicesIntro: Retaining and feature walls in stone, brick, sleeper or corten steel. Paving, pool coping, garden edging and concreting. Decks, pergolas, fencing and privacy screens. Rockeries, garden beds, turf, synthetic grass, irrigation, lighting, water features and ponds. School playgrounds and sensory gardens too.
copy.apertureLine: Bring the idea. We will work out how to build it.
copy.workIntro: Six jobs from around Canberra and the ACT, six different sites. Stone, paving, turf, rockeries, decks and water — every one of them built by the same team that quoted it.
copy.processIntro: From the first look at the space to the last plant in the ground, you are dealing with the same people the whole way.
copy.recognitionHeadline:
Three things a review
page will not tell you.
copy.reviewsIntro: Straight off our Google profile, word for word. Twenty-five reviews, 5.0 average.
copy.areasIntro: And the ACT surrounding areas. It is not a hard boundary either — if you are a bit further out than that, ring anyway and ask.
copy.enquireHeadline:
What do you want
to use it for?
copy.enquireIntro: That is the first thing Derek asks, and it decides everything else. Tell us what the space needs to do and roughly what you picture. Photos of it as it stands help more than anything.

owner.body: Derek is the one you ring, and the one who turns up to look at the space. Utopian Landscaping and Paving Solutions is a family run and operated business, and Derek is named by name in almost every review we have.
owner.team: Aaron is named in the reviews too — one client wrote that he worked through awful weather to get the job done on time and on budget. The crew gets described the same way over and over: reliable, energetic, courteous, trustworthy, and quick with a good idea for the space.

credentials.label: A school sensory garden and playground
credentials.body: We built the sensory garden and playground at a Canberra school — a sandpit, roly-poly slopes, stepping stones and artificial turf. The thank-you notes for that job came from Year 2 right through to Year 6.

credentials.label: Client letters, 2007 to 2020
credentials.body: Alongside the Google reviews there are the letters clients have written. The oldest is dated 19 November 2007, from John and Val in Macquarie; the most recent are from 2020. Retaining walls, whole front yards, and the school sensory garden.

priceLines._comment: Utopian publish no prices anywhere and no reviewer quotes one. Both left empty so the sentences that would carry a number stay hidden. Ask Derek before filling them in.

process.detail: Derek comes out and asks what you want to use the area for. That conversation decides everything after it. Bring a plan if you have one, or just tell him what is wrong with the space now.
If you have a design, we build to it. If you have half an idea, we fill in the rest. It is the thing clients mention most in their reviews — that we listened, then came back with ideas of our own.
Changed your mind? So did the client who wrote to us in 2007 — to thank us for re-quoting again and again, and for none of it ever being a problem.
Walls, paving, decking, turf, irrigation, planting, lighting — all of it by the same team. Nothing gets handed to a stranger halfway through.

reviews.name: Kelli Hughes
reviews.text: Derek and his team were a pleasure to have on site. Reliable, energetic and they did a great job of ripping out my front garden and re-landscaping it. They were courteous and trustworthy and came up with good ideas for improving the space. It’s going to look great in a year or two when the new plantings develop

reviews.name: Charlie Stephenson
reviews.text: Derek and the team were fantastic! Great communication throughout the job and the finished work was just what we were after. Derek was able to integrate our native garden into the new landscaping project which included rockeries, paving, turf, irrigation and other features. Utopian is highly recommended.

reviews.name: Patrick Foley
reviews.text: Aaron was really helpful, turning my rough ideas into a practical reality. He was very committed, working through awful weather to get my landscaping done on time and on budget. Im very happy with the finished product, well done Aaron.

reviews.name: Bradley Wood
reviews.text: Derek and his team did a great job with our landscaping. They were very reasonably priced, and were receptive to our ideas as well as communicating well to us on ideas of their own.

reviews.name: Michael Forsythe
reviews.text: They came and did a small paving job for me, converting a soggy dying townhouse lawn into crisp tightly-paved space.

reviews.name: Kathleen Cross
reviews.text: Derek and his team did a wonderful job transforming our once drab backyard into a beautiful oasis we now love spending time in with family and friends.

faq.q: Do I need a design before I ring?
faq.a: No. If you have plans drawn up, we build to them — that is exactly what we do. If all you have is a rough idea and a yard you are sick of looking at, that is enough to start with. Bradley Wood's review puts it plainly: “receptive to our ideas as well as communicating well to us on ideas of their own”.

faq.q: Do you take small jobs, or only big ones?
faq.a: Both. Anything from a small courtyard to a rural property. One of the reviews on this page is a townhouse lawn that was soggy and dying and is now tightly paved; another is a whole backyard with rockeries, paving, turf and irrigation.

faq.q: Do you do the whole job, or subcontract parts of it out?
faq.a: The whole job. Walls, paving, decking, fencing, screens, turf, irrigation, lighting, concreting and planting are all done in-house, which is the reason you only have to deal with one business and get one quote.

faq.q: Do you do schools and commercial work?
faq.a: Yes. School playgrounds and sensory gardens are on our list, and one of the biggest jobs we have done is a school sensory garden and playground — a sandpit, roly-poly slopes, stepping stones and artificial turf. The children wrote the thank-you notes for that one themselves, Year 2 right through to Year 6.
Canberra, Queanbeyan, Yass and the ACT surrounding areas. It is not a hard boundary, so if you are a bit further out than that, ring and ask.
